refnamediv.refpurpose: Image Processing and Computer Vision Toolbox for Scilab, an interface to OpenCV

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: IPCV gives access to the OpenCV library from Scilab. Images and video frames are handled as ordinary Scilab matrices and hypermatrices, and the functions of the toolbox call OpenCV through C++ gateways.

The toolbox covers image reading, display and exploration, color space conversions, arithmetic, filtering, morphological operations, geometric transformations, image enhancement and restoration, segmentation, structural analysis, feature detection, description and matching, image registration and stitching, super resolution, object detection and tracking, deep learning inference, and camera and video handling.
The binary versions of IPCV ship with OpenCV 5.1 (including the opencv_contrib modules).
